title: Zoning map change for Monitor Point, Greenpoint
summary: This amends the zoning map to rezone land near Franklin Street and Quay Street in Greenpoint, Brooklyn from manufacturing (M3-1) and lower-density residential (R6) districts to higher-density R8 and R6 districts, including a new commercial overlay. It is one of several linked land use actions that would allow a mixed-use development with about 1,150 homes, including 300 income-restricted units, plus commercial and community space. The Council held a public hearing on May 27, 2026 and its Land Use Committee acted on June 25, 2026.
